notes: Aggregate bit rate 103.1 Gb/s stated in features. Reach: up to 80 km on G.652 SMF with FEC (features/ordering); Section 2 lists link distance without FEC max 30 km and with FEC max 40 km (Note 1: for fiber insertion loss 0.4 dB/km). Rx sensitivity values are OMA at stated BER (1e-12 or 5e-5); stressed vs unstressed pairs listed. Average receive power ranges -16.9 to -4.9 dBm (30 km) and -20.9 to -4.9 dBm (40 km). TDP each lane -0.65 to 2.5 dB; vertical eye closure penalty 1.5 dB is a stressed sensitivity test condition per Note 4, not a module penalty point. Min launch power based on ER not exceeding 9.5 dB per optical Note 1.
provenance_datasheet_sections: 2. Recommended Operating Conditions and Power Supply Requirements
suggestions: Datasheet does not state modulation format, FEC type, OSNR, or CD/PMD/PDL tolerance. tx_power_max includes both per-lane average launch (4.5 dBm) and total average launch power (10.5 dBm)—consider splitting schema fields for per-lane vs aggregate TX power.
